an5.160:1.1: CLX. Pañc'ime bhikkhave uppannā duppaṭivinodayā. Katame pañca? Uppanno rāgo duppaṭivinodayo, uppanno doso duppaṭivinodayo, uppanno moho duppaṭivinodayo, uppannaṃ paṭibhānaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ, uppannaṃ gamikacittaṃ duppaṭivinodayaṃ. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca uppannā duppaṭivinodayā ti. Saddhammavaggo soḷasamo.
an5.160:2.0: Tass' uddānaṃ: Tayo saddhammaniyāmā tayo saddhammasammosā Dukkathā sārajjaṃ c'eva Udāyi dubbinodayā ti.
